data.name: Twist Master
data.detailed_description:
Twist Master

Twist Master is a relaxing and challenging 3×3 cube puzzle game designed for players of all skill levels. Experience smooth, realistic cube controls with both mouse and keyboard support. Whether you're a beginner learning your first solve or an experienced cuber chasing faster times, there's always a challenge waiting for you.

Five Game Modes

Classic Mode
No time or move limits. Relax and enjoy solving at your own pace.

Timer Mode
Race against the clock and complete the cube before time runs out.

Moves Mode
Solve the cube using a limited number of moves and discover the most efficient solutions.

Memory Mode
Study the scrambled cube, memorize its state, then solve it from memory after it disappears from view.

Direction Mode
Observe a target cube pattern and recreate it on a blank cube using your observation skills.

Customize Your Cube

Upload your own images and apply them to all six sides of the cube. Create unique designs and save your favorite styles.

Beginner Friendly

Learn with step-by-step tutorials designed for new players. No experience required.

Features

• Adjustable sensitivity and rotation speed
• Multiple language support
• Immersive sound effects and music
• Clean and intuitive interface
